description: This file defines the GeneratorPooledCache class which implements caching for a generator stream provider in Orleans. It manages buffered message serialization, caching, and eviction strategies for streaming data.

classes.name: GeneratorPooledCache
classes.description: A cache implementation for Orleans generator stream provider utilizing pooled buffers and custom eviction strategies.

classes.name: GeneratorPooledCache.Cursor
classes.description: An internal cursor class to iterate over cached batch containers.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Deserializes a cached message into an IBatchContainer.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Returns a sequence token for a cached message.

methods.name: QueueMessageToCachedMessage
methods.description: Converts a batch container to a cached message with stream position.

methods.name: SerializeMessageIntoPooledSegment
methods.description: Serializes a batch container's payload into a pooled segment buffer.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Creates a StreamPosition object from a batch container.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of batch containers to the cache.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge items from the cache based on the eviction strategy.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor for iterating over cache items starting from a specific stream and token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Indicates if the cache is under pressure (full or strained).
